voice: the assistant's private memory store, written in third person about the user
format: one memory note per line, each prefixed with a note id and a created date like 'mem#0142 (2024-03-05):'; rules as 'RULE:' lines; pending item under a 'TODO' header
verbosity: terse, telegraphic fragments; abbreviations like 'pref', 'w/', 'approx' are fine outside VERBATIM strings
notes: Group notes loosely by topic but never merge two notes into one.
